subject: v-sy
title: V.SY.------INFO.DY.
description: Chart on book p. 361 (R(AS)CM(II)-5). V-SY (value system) is the subject; INFO-DY (information dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: CULT-INFO-F (culture information focus) and UPB (underlying philosophical basis). From CULT-INFO-F: DEF (definition). From UPB: IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics) and LK-IMP (linkage implications). From IF-ST-DY: INFO-AF-B (information affinity basis). From LK-IMP: CULT-AF-B (culture affinity basis) and SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics).
